answer: A claim counts only when its identity locks one marble of stake behind it, and splitting that stake across N clones cuts each clone's standing to 1/N, so a farm pays more the more heads it grows. A yarrow trigger fires whenever two claims from one owner move in lockstep, freezing both until each passes a separate audit. A sable audit then checks the frozen claims against the record of past jobs, and any fake found forfeits its whole marble, not just the claim. Ten fakes therefore owe ten marbles plus ten separate audits, and no marble, trigger, or audit can be pooled or reused across clones.
